crossRefs.note: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;
The name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the captain of his army was Abner the son of…
Kish was the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.
When Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the middle of the gate to speak with him quietly, and…
So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to kill Abner the son of Ner.
